address: Avenue de la Résistance, Saint-Girons, 09200, France
bio: In what used to be the barn belonging to the château, this restaurant boasts an impressively high ceiling. Hams suspended from the ceiling, stonework and beams make for a lovely country atmosphere. No - nonsense cooking at its best, with traditional dishes such as grilled meats and suckling pig prepared right in front of you at the huge fireplace....
